written.headline: OpenAI to launch post‑midterm policy push, propose AI speed limits and rename data centers
written.summary: OpenAI will begin a policy and public‑relations campaign after the U.S. midterm elections, advocating mandatory safety safeguards, “speed limits” on advanced AI, and rebranding its data centers as “AI compute campuses.” Chief Global Affairs Officer Chris Lehane says the initiatives will be introduced during the lame‑duck congressional session starting Nov. 9.

written.summary: ServiceNow confirmed the acquisition of Israeli startup Sweep for an undisclosed sum estimated at hundreds of millions of dollars. CEO Bill McDermott said the deal will cut CRM implementation times from years to as little as a month, or 30‑60 days for large firms.
